use_case: Track and equipment defect detection (computer vision) from camera kits on 24 hi-rail inspection vehicles
vendor_or_model: Track inspection vision vendor model, fine-tuned by the company data science team
data_categories: Track imagery with location and time; inspector findings (Internal; bridge imagery Restricted)
human_in_the_loop: A designated track inspector reviews every AI flag and makes every compliance decision; the AI supplements, never replaces, the required visual inspection
applicable_laws: 49 CFR 213.233(a)-(b) (devices may supplement visual inspection by a person designated under 213.7); POL-04 4.9; SD 1580/82-2022-01E only if connected to a Critical Cyber System (it is not)
protected_characteristic_inputs: None (images of track; faces of roadway workers or the public are blurred at capture)
validation_status: Vendor Class I data plus a first local test set; recall gap on jointed and excepted track (POAM-022)
monitoring: Monthly recall on inspector-confirmed defects by track class and region; false positive rate per 100 miles

use_case: Machine vision car inspection portals flagging wheel, brake, coupler, and safety appliance defects
data_categories: Car images; car numbers; defect labels
human_in_the_loop: Qualified car inspectors confirm every flag; required inspections continue
applicable_laws: 49 CFR 215.13 (pre-departure inspection); 174.9 for hazmat cars (security inspection stays human)
monitoring: Monthly confirmed-defect agreement rate; missed-defect review of every bad-order car found after a portal pass
